internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service High Error Rate Due to Payment Service Issue
internal.body:
At 12:14 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Investigation revealed that the root cause was an error injection in the payment service causing a 50% error rate, which cascaded to the checkout service (47.5% error rate) and frontend (25% error rate).

The issue was diagnosed and a flag disabling the payment failure was proposed and approved at 12:34 UTC. The flag was set to false, which immediately reduced the error rates to normal levels, verified by monitoring metrics.

Timeline:
- 12:14:16: Alert received for checkout service error rate spike.
- 12:34:01: Diagnosis identified payment service error injection as primary fault.
- 12:34:07: Flag to disable payment failure set after approval.
- 12:34:07: Recovery verified with error rates returning to baseline.

No further impact was observed after mitigation.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing issues
external.body: Between 12:14 and 12:34 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing their checkout due to a problem in the payment processing system. Our team identified the issue quickly and implemented a fix that resolved the problem. Checkout service error rates have returned to normal, and all systems are operating as expected. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.
